inspiration.observed_pattern: A standings report normalizes home and away fixture rows into one team-perspective relation with UNION ALL, derives grouped appearance counts and aggregate score totals from that relation, and joins both summaries back to the club table for deterministic ranking.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent club-fixture leaderboard. Home and visitor scores become points, goals-for, goals-against, and margin through two UNION ALL branches; two grouped summaries are joined to clubs, while an unplayed club demonstrates the source's inner-join exclusion. The source schema, identifiers, labels, values, and sports prompt are not copied.

fixture_notes: Aurora, Beacon, and Comet have five fixed fixtures with wins, a draw, and a reverse fixture; Drift has no fixture and is excluded by the inner summary joins. The final order is points descending, margin descending, then club name.
determinism_notes: Club IDs, fixture IDs, scores, tie-break ordering, and all labels are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE leaderboard_clubs (club_id INT PRIMARY KEY, club_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE leaderboard_fixtures (fixture_id INT PRIMARY KEY, home_club_id INT NOT NULL, away_club_id INT NOT NULL, home_score INT NOT NULL, away_score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH club_results AS (SELECT home_club_id AS club_id, CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN 3 WHEN home_score = away_score THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS points_awarded, home_score AS goals_for, away_score AS goals_against, home_score - away_score AS goal_margin FROM leaderboard_fixtures UNION ALL SELECT away_club_id AS club_id, CASE WHEN home_score > away_score THEN 0 WHEN home_score = away_score THEN 1 ELSE 3 END AS points_awarded, away_score AS goals_for, home_score AS goals_against, away_score - home_score AS goal_margin FROM leaderboard_fixtures), appearance_counts AS (SELECT club_id, COUNT(*) AS games_played FROM club_results GROUP BY club_id) SELECT clubs.club_name, appearance_counts.games_played, totals.points, totals.goals_for, totals.goals_against, totals.goal_margin FROM leaderboard_clubs AS clubs INNER JOIN appearance_counts ON appearance_counts.club_id = clubs.club_id INNER JOIN (SELECT club_id, SUM(points_awarded) AS points, SUM(goals_for) AS goals_for, SUM(goals_against) AS goals_against, SUM(goal_margin) AS goal_margin FROM club_results GROUP BY club_id) AS totals ON totals.club_id = clubs.club_id ORDER BY totals.points DESC, totals.goal_margin DESC, clubs.club_name ASC

checks.sql: SELECT club_id, club_name FROM leaderboard_clubs ORDER BY club_id
SELECT fixture_id, home_club_id, away_club_id, home_score, away_score FROM leaderboard_fixtures ORDER BY fixture_id
